title: SWE-bench Lite — first-call context statistics per harness
note: Bars: mean per harness. Whiskers: ±1 standard deviation across attempts.

definitions.instruction_chars: characters of the system/developer instructions of the first main request: the Messages `system` field, or the Responses `instructions` plus system/developer input messages, or Chat Completions system/developer messages
definitions.tool_count: tool definitions declared on the first main request (`tools`, plus Responses `additional_tools` items)
definitions.tool_schema_chars: characters of the compact JSON of those tool definitions
definitions.first_call_context_tokens: provider-reported prompt of the first main call: uncached input + cache creation + cache read tokens, from the same terminal usage object the usage replay reads
definitions.main_request: Claude Code: the request its sealed inference topology names as the coding-agent main request; Codex and Pi: the first request with a parseable body and a terminal usage
